about: An order line is held only to being numbers, so a zero, negative or fractional quantity and a negative or fractional price are accepted and stored; no public test sees it.

mutations.find: const validLine = (l) => Number.isInteger(l?.qty) && l.qty > 0 && Number.isInteger(l?.unitMinor) && l.unitMinor >= 0;
mutations.replace: const validLine = (l) => typeof l?.qty === "number" && typeof l?.unitMinor === "number";
